import React from 'react'; import { Container, Typography, Grid, Card, CardContent, Box, Chip, } from '@mui/material'; import { School as SchoolIcon, Work as WorkIcon, Assignment as AssignmentIcon, CheckCircle as CheckCircleIcon, Pending as PendingIcon, } from '@mui/icons-material'; import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'; const StudentDashboard = () => { const { currentUser } = useAuth(); // Mock data - replace with actual API calls later const dashboardData = { stats: { applications: currentUser?.profile?.applications?.length || 0, pendingApplications: currentUser?.profile?.applications?.filter(app => app.status === 'pending')?.length || 0, approvedApplications: currentUser?.profile?.applications?.filter(app => app.status === 'approved')?.length || 0, institutionsApplied: currentUser?.profile?.applications?.filter(app => app.type === 'institution')?.length || 0, jobsApplied: currentUser?.profile?.applications?.filter(app => app.type === 'job')?.length || 0 } }; const data = dashboardData; return ( {/* Welcome Section */} Welcome back, {currentUser?.profile?.personalInfo?.firstName || 'Student'}! Here's your academic and career journey overview {/* Statistics Grid */} Total Applications {data.stats.applications} All time Pending {data.stats.pendingApplications} Awaiting review Approved {data.stats.approvedApplications} Successful applications Institutions {data.stats.institutionsApplied} Applied to {/* Profile Completion */} Profile Completion Personal Information Academic Records Career Preferences {/* Quick Stats */} Application Status Institution Applications Job Applications Pending Reviews Approved {/* Recent Activity */} Getting Started Welcome to your dashboard! Use the navigation bar above to:
  • Browse and apply to educational institutions
  • Explore job opportunities from partner companies
  • Track your application status
  • Update your profile and academic records
 ); }; export default StudentDashboard;
